ai_overview_references.title: Which sources ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini cite when ...

answer_text:
Based on original research published by UX Continuum (conducted by Matt Turley between September 24 and September 30, 2026), Perplexity cited an average of 20.0 sources per answer. uxcontinuum.com
The study analyzed AI engines' behaviors when answering local business recommendation and hiring questions (such as "who should I hire"). It highlighted that Perplexity was highly dense in its citations compared to other AI tools like ChatGPT (7.4 sources per answer) and Gemini (10.0 sources per answer). uxcontinuum.com
